entry.title: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee: the meeting of 31 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Committee voted the current town hall (Ritter) building is too small and needs an addition. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kY5j-uu0MRo), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
